objective: Launch two contracts in this repository on Robinhood Chain, in this order, without changing their logic. 1) src/ConditionalsV2.sol:ConditionalsV2, constructor (address owner = $owner, IERC20 imd = 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, IIntake intake = 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, address oracleSigner = 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982, address feeRecipient = FEE_RECIPIENT). 2) src/ConditionalsZap.sol:ConditionalsZap, constructor (ConditionalsV2 conditionals = $contract:ConditionalsV2, IPoolManager poolManager = 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, IERC20 imd = 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, IERC20 usdg = 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168). Neither constructor makes external calls. ConditionalsV2 is a conditional prediction market in IMD settled by the IdentityMD oracle. A market asks 'if CONDITION, will OUTCOME?' with four outcomes (index 2*world+side). A share of the outcome that happens pays 1 IMD. The creator deposits two 0.5 IMD oracle questions plus a neutral seed of b ln 4 that funds an LMSR maker (0.5 to 100 IMD b, Solady expWad and lnWad, log-sum-exp, rounding margins that keep makerBalance >= C(q) >= every q[i]); the seed is the creator's maximum loss. Until closeTime: stakeConditional (and stakeFor, paid by the caller and credited to an account) mints a complete set, sells the opposite side to the maker and buys more of the chosen side, so the stake is paid in its world on its side and refunded in the other world; buy, sell and exit trade with the maker with slippage bounds. Every maker trade pays 2%: half accrues to the creator in owed, 67/200 is sent to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD because IMD reverts on transfers to zero, and the rest accrues to feeRecipient in owed. When the maker is short of every outcome it turns those complete sets back into IMD (_absorb). The oracle flow is unchanged from Conditionals v1, IMD launch 2278, audited: after resolveTime anyone calls requestResolution, the contract pays the Intake with requestWithFailure for oracle.request@oracle-1 questions (panel 5, quorum 4, bool, panel evidence, window pinned to one Ethereum block, block.number - 10, since block.number on Robinhood Chain is the Ethereum block number) and stores keccak256 of each canonical question document. onOracleResult (selector 0x510379c7) accepts an answer only from the Intake for its own pending request, with the stored questionHash, answerType bool, panelSize and quorum at least the market's, agreed >= quorum, not expired, and an EIP-712 signature (domain IdentityMD Oracle, version 2) from the market's oracle signer. onFailure (0x5a0df71e) only clears the ask. Settlement pays 1 IMD per share of the outcome that happened and gives the creator the maker's residual and unspent budget. With no usable answer 30 days after resolveTime anyone can void: accounts get their net IMD in back excluding fees, pro rata if short, and the creator is paid last. The owner can only propose an oracle configuration for future markets behind a 3 day delay and set the fee recipient; it cannot touch trades, answers or open markets. No token, no proxy, no pause. ConditionalsZap has no owner and holds nothing between calls. stakeWithEth and stakeWithUsdg swap exact input through two hookless Uniswap v4 pools (USDG to ETH, fee 500, spacing 10; ETH to IMD, fee 10000, spacing 100) inside one PoolManager unlock, revert on a partial fill or below the caller's minImd, and call stakeFor for the caller. All positions, exits and payouts are in IMD in ConditionalsV2. ConditionalsV2's runtime is close to the 24,576 byte limit with optimizer_runs 1, so any fix must keep it under. legacy/ holds the deployed v1 for reference and is not built. The test suite (unit, fuzz, invariant, oracle conformance vector and a live-API question-hash vector; fork tests with FORK_ROBINHOOD=1) must keep passing.
